artifact_observations.reasoning: The metallic soleplate lacks fine micro-scratches or detailed texture expected from real metal; it appears slightly 'smudged' or overly smooth, lacking high-frequency detail.
The power cord merges into the plastic body without a clear strain relief or plug housing; it appears to float slightly or melt into the casing rather than being mechanically anchored.
The text or indicators on the temperature dial are illegible and smeared, a common artifact in AI-generated text/symbols.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of iron and rule out misclassification as similar handheld appliances.
To rigorously check the connection point of the cord for fusion artifacts or boundary bleeding.
To analyze the metallic reflection and surface details for signs of synthetic smoothing or lack of physical realism.
To ensure the handle is properly connected to the body and not floating, and to verify the 3D consistency of the dial.

focus_areas: Connection integrity of the power cord to the main body
Legibility and structural correctness of the temperature dial
Realism of metallic reflections on the soleplate
Presence and clarity of steam holes on the soleplate
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the power cord attachment point; AI often fails to render the mechanical strain relief correctly, resulting in a 'melting' appearance. Also, scrutinize the dial: if the numbers/markings are gibberish or asymmetrical, it is a strong indicator of generation. Check if the soleplate looks like a flat sticker rather than a 3D metal object.
